content: ऊरव्यः Born from the thighs, hence a वैश्य, a merchant; विप्राश्च बाहुजास्तद्वदूरव्याश्च जघन्यजाः <ls>Śiva B. 31. 17</ls>.
ऊरव्यः (-व्या|{%f.%}) [ऊरु-यत्] A Vaiśya, a man of the third tribe (as born from the thighs of Brahmā or Puruṣa); <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ms. 1. 31</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 1.">87</ls>.
